content:
Starting a new video series where I port an NES emulator from Haskell to Lean, specifically for the purpose of exploring Lean's subtyping.

https://youtu.be/3TBUiTS6wyY

In episode 2, we look at binding to Raylib via Lean's Foreign Function Interface.

https://youtu.be/a3-BPhKDTuU
Nice, do you have a repository to share ?

It's just my local git for right now; a lot of what I'm doing is exploring subtyping and proving properties of the CPU and I am still firmly in the "I have no idea what I'm doing" phase. If it gets far enough along that I think others could use it I'll consider putting it on GitHub.
